metadata.question: Was the vegetation anomaly in February 21-28 2019 (compared to the long-term average of the same month from 2003-2017) worse in Namibia than Zimbabwe?

data.raw_code: To answer this question, I need to: 1. Define geometries for Namibia and Zimbabwe 2. Get vegetation data for both time periods: - February 21-28, 2019 (target period) - February 21-28, averaged from 2003-2017 (baseline period) 3. Calculate vegetation anomaly as the difference between 2019 and baseline 4. Compare the anomalies between Namibia and Zimbabwe For vegetation, I'll use NDVI from MODIS (MOD13Q1) which provides consistent long-term data. - Collection: MODIS/006/MOD13Q1 - Band: NDVI - Scale: 250m I need to: 1. Check if collections have data 2. Calculate mean NDVI for each country in both periods 3. Calculate anomaly (2019 - baseline) 4. Compare which country has worse anomaly (more negative) Structure: - Define country boundaries - Get 2019 data - Get baseline data (2003-2017 average for same dates) - Calculate anomalies - Validate results - Compare anomalies ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry Definitions const namibia = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0').filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Namibia')); const zimbabwe = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0').filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Zimbabwe')); // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS NDVI const modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13Q1').select('NDVI'); // 2019 period const period2019 = modisCol.filterDate('2019-02-21', '2019-02-28'); const period2019Size = period2019.size().getInfo(); // Baseline period (2003-2017) const baselineCol = modisCol.filterDate('2003-02-21', '2017-02-28') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(51, 59, 'day_of_year')); // Feb 21-28 equivalent const baselineSize = baselineCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${period2019Size}, Baseline Images: ${baselineSize}`); // Check for empty collections if (period2019Size === 0 || baselineSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean NDVI const ndvi2019 = period2019.mean().multiply(0.0001); // Scale factor const baselineMean = baselineCol.mean().multiply(0.0001); // Calculate anomalies const anomalyNamibia = ndvi2019.subtract(baselineMean).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: namibia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); const anomalyZimbabwe = ndvi2019.subtract(baselineMean).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: zimbabwe, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); const [anomNam, anomZim] = await Promise.all([ anomalyNamibia.getInfo(), anomalyZimbabwe.getInfo() ]); // Check for valid pixels if (anomNam === null || anomZim === null) { console.log("No valid pixels in one or both countries."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation errors if (isNaN(anomNam) || isNaN(anomZim) || Math.abs(anomNam) > 1 || Math.abs(anomZim) > 1) { console.log("Invalid NDVI anomaly values detected."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 4. Analysis - Compare anomalies (more negative = worse) console.log(`Namibia anomaly: ${anomNam.toFixed(4)}, Zimbabwe anomaly: ${anomZim.toFixed(4)}`); if (anomNam < anomZim) { console.log("A"); // Namibia worse than Zimbabwe } else { console.log("B"); // Zimbabwe worse or equal to Namibia } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
